rows.grounds: object of the imperative; denotes the immortal essence
compound qualifying amṛtaṃ; identifies nectar with Kaula reality
compound qualifying amṛtaṃ; specifies its constitution as Kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the nectar identified as the true Kaula essence?
premises: A nectar is presented as the object to be heard.
This nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This Kaula essence is constituted by Kāmakalā.
items.inference: The nectar that is the true Kaula essence has Kāmakalā as its intrinsic nature.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal nuance of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose very nature is Kāmakalā.
